battle.name: 緬恩斯戰役 (406年)
battle.theater: 底比斯以北的玻俄提亞平原
battle.brief: 公元前406年，斯巴達的萊山德在哈利阿斯戰敗後退守緬恩斯，營中留駐五百人莫拉。底比斯的佩洛皮達斯率七百人出城，以三百人神聖隊為骨幹突襲該營，斯巴達守軍陣亡約二百、被俘約一百，全隊覆沒。此役常被視為伯羅奔尼撒戰爭最後一場重裝步兵戰役，卡面科林斯青銅盔即其祖型。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭是公元前406年底比斯聯邦與斯巴達之間的一場遭遇戰，交戰地在玻俄提亞境內、底比斯城以北數公里的緬恩斯，色諾芬在《希臘史》三卷四章中把這個地名記作 Mêines，後世英文常寫 Menaius 一類的譯名。底比斯一方是當時聯盟政治的核心城邦：玻俄提亞同盟由十一個城邦組成，各城在聯邦議會有席位，戰時由七名玻俄阿提分掌兵權，底比斯城自己則握有一支三百人的神聖隊，聯盟另有各城湊成的步兵與騎兵。本役真正上手的是底比斯城出兵的一支七百人縱隊，內含三百名神聖隊，另有雅典盟軍在側翼一帶活動，但史料沒有留下雅典部隊的確切人數。斯巴達一方是一個五百人的莫拉，由一名和普斯多率領，隸屬於萊山德在緬恩斯近岸的營地與艦隊；萊山德此時身任監察官，隨五委員會同駐營，權責只在監督，並非這支分隊的指揮者。放在大背景裡，這是伯羅奔尼撒戰爭末期的局部動作：斯巴達在海陸兩方面同時吃緊，底比斯聯邦則得到波斯金援與雅典同盟的支持，實力正處在上升的檔口。
countriesEn: This was an engagement in 406 BC between the Boeotian League centred on Thebes and Sparta, fought in Boeotia a few kilometres north of the city of Thebes at a place Xenophon calls the Mêines in Hellenica 3.4, a name later anglicised in forms such as Menaius. The Theban side was the core city of the league politics of the time: the Boeotian confederacy was made up of eleven cities, each with seats in the federal council, and in time of war power was divided among seven Boeotarchs, while the city of Thebes itself held a Sacred Band of three hundred men and the league had infantry and cavalry contributed by the member cities. The force actually committed here was a column of seven hundred from the city of Thebes, three hundred of them the Sacred Band, with an Athenian allied contingent active in the flank; the sources preserve no exact figure for the Athenian troops. On the Spartan side stood a mora of five hundred men led by a harmost and belonging to the camp and fleet of Lysander on the shore below the Mêines; Lysander was at that time one of the ephors, present with the board of five, his authority being supervision rather than command of the detachment. In the larger setting this was a local action in the closing phase of the Peloponnesian War: Sparta was under strain on sea and land at once, while the Boeotian League, backed by Persian money and by an Athenian alliance, was on the rising side of the balance.
people: 主事者是底比斯的佩洛皮達斯。他是底比斯城邦的核心將領，出身名門，在城邦政治中的地位靠家世與戰功並舉；本役他率七百人出城迎敵，把最寶貴的三百名神聖隊握在手裡，關鍵時刻才投入正面，後世史家把這場勝利視為他一生最漂亮的地面戰果之一。底比斯的另一名領袖埃帕米農達斯是否在場，史料說法不一：普魯塔克在寫佩洛皮達斯時把勝利歸給底比斯的將領整體，後世也常把本役列為埃帕米農達斯的早期戰績，但色諾芬只直接提到佩洛皮達斯的指揮。斯巴達方面，萊山德是事件的另一個關鍵人物：他以海軍統帥兼監察官身份在場，目擊駐紮的莫拉被殲而沒有及時登岸支援，事後受到本邦與盟邦的責難，這在他日後的仕途上投下陰影。直接被擊敗的那支五百人莫拉，其率隊的和普斯多姓名沒有被記下來，是本役記載中最明顯的空白；唯一留下姓名的斯巴達指揮者，反而是那個沒有出手的萊山德。
peopleEn: The man in charge was Pelopidas of Thebes. He was the leading general of the Theban city, born of a distinguished house, and his standing in the politics of the city rested on birth and on proven service alike; here he marched out with seven hundred men and kept back the three hundred of the Sacred Band as his reserve, committing them to the line only at the decisive moment, and later historians treat this victory as one of the finest results he ever won on the field. Whether Epaminondas was present is not settled: Plutarch, writing of Pelopidas, credits the victory to the Theban generals as a body, and later tradition often lists the battle among Epaminondas's early exploits, but Xenophon names only Pelopidas as the commander. On the Spartan side the other key figure was Lysander. He was there as admiral and ephor, and he watched the garrison mora annihilated without coming ashore to support it, which drew criticism from his own city and from its allies and cast a shadow over the rest of his career. The harmost who actually led the five hundred men that were destroyed is not named in any source, which is the most conspicuous gap in the record of the battle; the only Spartan commander whose name survives is the man who did not fight.
kits: 卡面這頂科林斯青銅盔鑄造於公元前650年前後，是希臘重裝步兵盔的祖型：青銅薄片鑲在內襯之上，面部只留一道窄窄的開眼與鼻口之間的縫隙，頭盔一旦戴上，周邊視野便幾乎全失。此類頭盔的工藝源出科林斯工匠，公元前五世紀前期已在希臘世界普及；到公元前406年，完整封閉、眼縫狹窄的科林斯式樣在戰場上已算老式，當時底比斯與斯巴達重裝步兵頭上所戴多是它的後裔——保留青銅盔身與馬鬃盔飾、但面頰兩側加裝可放下或翻起的護頰、面部大體開啟的通用式樣子。卡面這一頂正好是一把尺子：全封閉面甲把雙手與眼睛一併綁在隊形上，它的後代則是開放式的，讓人能看見左右，也讓人能聽見號令。雙方步兵的其餘裝備大致相同：直徑約九十公分的圓盾，正面蒙青銅皮、邊緣留有把手缺口；兩米上下、以梣木為桿、矛頭為鐵或青銅的長矛；短劍；以及亞麻布胸甲、綁腿與銅脛甲。斯巴達步兵另以深紅色外袍在遠處辨識隊形，萊山德的三列槳戰船隊駐紮在緬恩斯近岸，艦隊才是這支陸戰分隊真正的依托。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card was made around 650 BC and is the archetype of the Greek hoplite helmet: a sheet of bronze fitted over a liner, with nothing in the face but a narrow eye slit and a gap between nose and mouth, so that once the helmet is on the field of view is practically gone. The craft came from Corinthian workshops and had spread through the Greek world in the early fifth century; by 406 BC the fully closed Corinthian form with its slit eyes was already old-fashioned on the battlefield, and the hoplites of both Thebes and Sparta wore for the most part its descendant, keeping the bronze skull and the horsehair crest but adding hinged cheek-pieces that could be dropped or raised and leaving the face largely open. The card's helmet is therefore a useful yardstick: the fully closed face-piece binds the hands and the eyes of the wearer alike to the formation, while its descendant is open, able to see to the flanks and able to hear the calls. The rest of the infantry equipment was much the same on both sides: a round shield of about ninety centimetres across, faced with bronze and notched at the rim to take the grip; a spear about two metres long with an ash shaft and an iron or bronze head; a short sword; and a linen cuirass, greaves and bronze shin-guards. Spartan infantry were marked in the distance by their deep red cloaks, and Lysander's triremes lay off the shore below the Mêines; the fleet was the real base of this land detachment.
tactics: 底比斯這一方把會戰地點選在對自己有利的地形上。緬恩斯一帶是底比斯城北的起伏地帶，谷地與坡地相間，斯巴達營地設在低處，底比斯人則佔據較高的斜面，讓對手的重裝步兵必須在爬升與收束隊形之間失去秩序。作戰過程中最關鍵的兩步是等待與投入：底比斯人沒有一開始就把全部兵力壓上去，而是先讓斯巴達莫拉進入預定的接戰地域，由前線以盾牆頂住，盡量把對手拖在不利於重裝步兵發揮的坡地上；待其隊形展開、縱深被地形切斷之後，佩洛皮達斯才把一直留作後手的三百人神聖隊投入正面，掩護全隊一舉壓上。斯巴達方面也循固定的步兵做法：依希臘人的傳統，最精銳的連隊放在右翼，五百人一旦在坡地下遭俯衝，縱深難以展開，被擠壓在狹窄地帶；據普魯塔克的敘述，和普斯多沒有採納退入營地重整的勸告，最後選擇留在原地作戰。另一個關鍵在後勤：底比斯軍出城僅數公里，糧秣與援兵可由城內補給；斯巴達營地則依賴海岸的艦隊與外來的糧食，一旦營地失守，留在平原上的分隊等於被切斷。整場戰鬥沒有弓弩、沒有騎兵、沒有攻城器械，純粹是重裝步兵之間的角力。
tacticsEn: The Thebans chose the ground to suit themselves. The country round the Mêines is broken ground north of Thebes, where hollows alternate with slopes; the Spartan camp stood on the lower ground while the Thebans took the higher incline, forcing the opposing hoplites to lose their order between the climb and the tightening of the ranks. The two decisive steps in the action were the waiting and the committing. The Thebans did not throw in everything at the start; they let the Spartan mora enter the ground they had marked out, held the front with a wall of shields and kept the enemy engaged on ground unfavourable to hoplite manoeuvre, and only when the Spartan formation had opened out and its depth had been cut by the terrain did Pelopidas commit the three hundred of the Sacred Band, which he had held back, into the line, covering the general advance of the whole force. The Spartans followed the fixed conventions of their infantry as well: by the Greek custom the best companies held the right wing, and once the five hundred were charged downhill their depth could not open and they were squeezed into a narrow space, while, in Plutarch's account, the harmost did not take the advice to fall back into the camp and re-form but chose to stand and fight where he was. Logistics mattered as much as the manoeuvre: the Theban column had marched only a few kilometres from the city, so grain and reinforcements could be drawn from inside the walls, whereas the Spartan camp depended on the fleet on the coast and on grain brought in from outside, and once the camp itself was in danger the detachment left in the plain was in effect cut off. There was no archery, no cavalry and no siege engine in the action; it was a pure trial of strength between bodies of hoplites.
data: 可以確定的數字不多，但都出自色諾芬《希臘史》三卷四章。交戰的斯巴達分隊是一個五百人的莫拉，常被稱作「五百人」；底比斯出動七百人，其中三百人屬神聖隊；斯巴達方面的損耗，色諾芬記為陣亡約二百人、被俘約一百人，兩相加幾乎等於全部分隊。底比斯方面的自身損耗，史料沒有留下數字，只能從戰果與戰局推知為輕微。時間上，本役夾在公元前406年春天哈利阿斯之敗與同年九月阿里吉努塞海戰之間：萊山德在哈利阿斯折損了兄弟波勒馬科斯並自己受傷，退到緬恩斯；本役之後斯巴達海軍在阿里吉努塞受挫，翌年又在赫勒斯滂多斯海峽與埃戈斯波塔米接連失利，最終在公元前404年以雅典投降收場。距離上，緬恩斯在底比斯城以北數公里，底比斯軍隊往返全在城邦控制範圍之內。本役常被稱為伯羅奔尼撒戰爭最後一場重裝步兵戰役；至於具體月份，傳世記載沒有明確標明，卡面標為五月，是取其緊接春季哈利阿斯之戰、又早於九月海戰的合理推測。
dataEn: The figures that can be fixed are not many, but they all come from Xenophon, Hellenica 3.4. The Spartan detachment was a mora of five hundred, commonly referred to as the Five Hundred; Thebes put seven hundred into the field, of whom three hundred were the Sacred Band; the Spartan losses are given as about two hundred killed and about one hundred taken prisoner, which together account for almost the whole detachment. No figures are preserved for Theban losses, and they can only be inferred from the result and from the course of the action to have been light. In time the battle falls between the defeat at Haliartus in the spring of 406 BC and the naval battle of Arginusae in September of the same year: at Haliartus Lysander lost his brother Polemarchus and was himself wounded, and withdrew to the Mêines; after the Mêines the Spartan fleet was checked at Arginusae, and in the following year it suffered further defeats at the Hellespont and at Aegospotami, the war finally closing with the surrender of Athens in 404 BC. In distance the Mêines lies a few kilometres north of Thebes, and the Theban column moved to and fro entirely within the territory of its own city. The battle is commonly called the last hoplite battle of the Peloponnesian War; as for the exact month, the transmitted record does not fix it, and the card gives May as a reasonable inference from a date that follows the spring defeat at Haliartus and precedes the naval battle of September.
cause: 開戰的直接契機是斯巴達在哈利阿斯受挫後的退卻。公元前406年，斯巴達在玻俄提亞的行動原本要打通通往比奧西亞的陸路、並就近監視底比斯城，結果在哈利阿斯一戰折損主將，萊山德本人受傷，被迫把海軍退到緬恩斯一帶的錨地，實質上是把戰場推到了底比斯的城牆之下。對底比斯人來說，這是不能容忍的局勢：城邦的安全從此直接繫在斯巴達的艦隊上，而斯巴達恰恰是過去數十年在希臘大陸壓倒底比斯的對手。更深一層的原因是公元前406年整個戰局的天平正在移動——斯巴達在海外同時面對重建中的雅典海軍與受波斯資助的敵人，兵力和注意力被攤薄；底比斯聯邦則靠波斯的金錢與雅典的同盟，實力正處於上升期，統帥們需要一場足以震動整個希臘世界的勝利來確立新的聲望。於是底比斯主動出城迎敵，把一場原本只是偵察與對峙的局面變成正面會戰。戰術層面上，底比斯也想藉此證明：只要地形與紀律安排得當，斯巴達的方陣並非不可擊破。
causeEn: The immediate occasion for the fighting was the withdrawal of the Spartans after their reverse at Haliartus. The Spartan operations in Boeotia in 406 BC were meant to open a land route towards the Gulf and to keep watch over Thebes from close to hand, but at Haliartus they lost a commander, Lysander was himself wounded, and he was forced to draw his fleet back to the anchorage at the Mêines, which in effect carried the war to the walls of Thebes. For the Thebans that was an intolerable situation: the security of the city now hung directly on the Spartan fleet, and Sparta was precisely the power that had dominated Thebes on the Greek mainland for the previous decades. At a deeper level the balance of the whole war was shifting in 406 BC: Sparta faced at once the rebuilt Athenian navy overseas and enemies financed by Persia, and its soldiers and its attention were spread thin, while the Boeotian League, with Persian money and an Athenian alliance behind it, was on the rising side of the scale, and its commanders needed a victory loud enough to shake the whole Greek world in order to establish a new reputation. So Thebes marched out to meet the enemy and turned what had been a situation of reconnaissance and waiting into a set-piece engagement. At the tactical level the Thebans also wanted to show that the Spartan phalanx could be broken, provided the ground and the discipline were arranged properly.
impact: 本役的意義超出了戰術本身。斯巴達引以為傲的形象是陸地上不可擊敗，這一形象在緬恩斯被一個五百人的分隊覆滅，等於被公開證偽；當時已經有「斯巴達人不再如往昔」的說法在流傳，底比斯的勝利在這樣的氣氛裡格外刺眼。它也直接影響了萊山德的仕途：本役之後不到一年，他就在阿里吉努塞之戰中因未救護落水將士而受審，名聲由盛轉衰，被卡里克拉特斯取代，此後再沒有得到他期望的指揮權。更大的結構性影響是讓希臘人看見，戰爭的決定權正在從方陣轉向艦隊與錢袋：底比斯靠波斯補貼與雅典同盟的資源崛起，斯巴達的陸軍榮耀則逐漸被海上補給線的負擔抵銷。底比斯由此獲得道德與物質上的雙重優勢，並在往後十多年裡以聯邦為核心主導希臘事務——從前395年的科林斯戰爭到前371年的留克特拉，底比斯國勢的基礎正是在這幾年奠下的。
impactEn: The meaning of the battle reached well beyond its tactics. The image Sparta prized above all was that it could not be beaten on land, and at the Mêines a detachment of five hundred was annihilated, which amounted to a public disproof of that image; there was already a saying current that the Spartans were no longer what they had been, and the Theban victory cut all the sharper in such a climate. It also struck directly at Lysander's career: within a year of this he was on trial after Arginusae for failing to pick up the drowning men, his reputation turned from the height of power to disgrace, he was replaced by Callicratidas, and he never again received the command he had been angling for. The larger structural effect was to let the Greeks see that the decision in the war was passing from the phalanx to the fleet and the purse: Thebes rose on Persian subsidies and on the resources of the Athenian alliance, while the glory of the Spartan land army was gradually offset by the burden of keeping a sea route supplied. Thebes thus gained both a moral and a material advantage, and over the following dozen years it came to lead Greek affairs through the league, from the Corinthian War of 395 BC to Leuctra in 371; the foundations of Theban power were laid in these very years.
result: 結果是底比斯的勝利，而且是一場乾淨的殲滅戰。佩洛皮達斯的縱隊擊潰斯巴達的五百人莫拉，約二百人陣亡、一百人被俘，這支分隊作為建制幾乎全滅；倖存者與陣亡者的屍體按希臘人的慣例在停戰協商下由敗方收殮，勝方在戰場上立起戰利品標記。萊山德與其艦隊安然退保海岸，他的政治處境卻由此惡化：本役的指揮責任落在監察官與和普斯多身上，斯巴達內部對此的追問延續到之後的海戰敗績。戰役本身沒有改變伯羅奔尼撒戰爭的最終結局——斯巴達在公元前405年的赫勒斯滂多斯海峽海戰中重拾制海權，翌年在埃戈斯波塔米決定性地擊潰雅典海軍，戰爭以斯巴達的勝利與雅典的投降收場。真正改變的是重心的轉移：底比斯以這一戰證明自己可以在陸上擊敗斯巴達，希臘各城邦對斯巴達的服從由此動搖，而愛琴海的勝負則在同年秋天的海戰裡交到了另一方手上。
resultEn: The result was a Theban victory, and a clean annihilation. Pelopidas's column broke the Spartan mora of five hundred: about two hundred were killed and about one hundred taken prisoner, and the detachment was virtually wiped out as a unit; by the Greek convention the survivors and the dead were gathered up for burial under a truce, and the victors set up a trophy on the field. Lysander and his fleet fell back to the coast in safety, but his political position worsened: responsibility for the action lay with the ephors and with the harmost, and the questioning of it inside Sparta continued into the naval defeats that followed. The battle itself did not change the final outcome of the Peloponnesian War: Sparta recovered the command of the sea at the battle of the Hellespont in 405 BC and in the following year destroyed the Athenian fleet decisively at Aegospotami, and the war ended in a Spartan victory and the surrender of Athens. What did change was the transfer of weight: Thebes had proved that it could beat Sparta on land, the obedience of the Greek cities to Sparta began to waver, and the decision over the Aegean passed in the naval fighting of the same autumn to the other side.
